Sources: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027/ published 2026-08-26; https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/ published 2026-05-20; https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026/ published 2026-02-25; SEC https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001045810.json. SBC = 6.386 + 3.954 - 3.099 = 7.241. Each is an analyst-independent estimation, not an observed consensus forecast or an issuer GAAP EPS forecast. NTM refers to the next 12 months after 2026-09-30; annualizing a quarterly guide assumes a constant quarterly run rate and omits seasonality. All estimates use only information publicly available by their stated snapshot date. Estimate revenue_ntm: 4 * next-quarter company revenue guide USD 108bn = 432bn; source https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027/, published 2026-08-26 (FY2027 Q3 guide). Estimate eps_ntm: GAAP diluted EPS/revenue ratio held at the then-known TTM level; 7.91 * 432 / 302.969 = 11.278777696728048. Sources https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027/ and SEC https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001045810.json. This assumes unchanged effective GAAP net margin and diluted shares. It does not convert issuer non-GAAP EPS into GAAP EPS. Margin/share/tax changes could materially alter the estimate. Estimate eps_ntm_90d: snapshot 2026-07-02, exactly 90 calendar days before valuation; same quarterly-guide annualization and GAAP EPS/revenue method as current eps_ntm, using only then-published https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/ (2026-05-20) and prior financial disclosures. 6.53 * (4 * 91) / 253.491 = 9.376743158534229. Prior TTM revenue = 215.938 + 81.615 - 44.062 = 253.491bn; prior GAAP diluted EPS = 1.08 + 1.30 + 1.76 + 2.39 = 6.53. SEC https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001045810.json; only filings <= 2026-07-02. This reconstructs a historical estimate, not a historically published consensus. No later actual results or September guidance enter this field.
